summary: 卡牌游戏与牌组构筑设计：卡牌数据化配一个效果解释器、牌区、触发栈和带种子的洗牌，适合杀戮尖塔、小丑牌类或集换式卡牌。 Designs card games and deckbuilders in any engine: cards as data with one effect interpreter, deck zones, a trigger stack and seeded shuffles. Use for a Slay the Spire- or Balatro-like or a TCG, or cards that duplicate or streaky shuffles. Pair with the engine skill for card data and hand UI (`godot-resources`, `godot-ui-control`, `unity-scriptableobjects`). Not for grid crawlers (`roguelike`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill card-game，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use for a Slay the Spire- or Balatro-like or a TCG, or cards that duplicate or streaky shuffles.
Workflow: Name the reference game and fix the frame; Model zones and cards as data; Pick the resolution model; Write a power budget.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：roguelike 用 gene_gdsk_roguelike_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
